training: empirical nearest-history votes; no weight training
task: First body farming last-hit origin in (t,t+30s], not a chosen destination, clear, safety or outcome of advice.

definitions.features: Patch/hero/team, clock, last fresh alive self XY at/before t, positive own main-slot item sightings through t only. No event origin, death XY, tower/camp status, opponents, gold or winner.
definitions.nextFamily: Primary coarse experiment: lane-of-origin vs own-spawn camp. Strict >1/2 of ALL historical votes/mass, minimum two accounts; otherwise abstain. No-action, opponent and unresolved stay in the voting denominator. Diagnostic only unless current user manually confirms an allowed target of that family; not evidence for a specific site.
definitions.censoring: Complete horizon only, even when a hit is known before truncation; later points/timestamps bound observation end only. Missing/dead self abstains.
definitions.baseline: Same train/hero/team, ±90s clock-only distribution, all accounts equally weighted; same min two accounts, no position/inventory.
definitions.coverage: Nonempty historical ranking / all fully observed label horizons (includes dead and no-fresh-self); also conditional on fresh alive prefix.
definitions.accuracy: Exact site among ranked windows with resolved truth. No-body-hit and opponent-camp count as misses. Unknown truth separately counted; top1HitsPerFullWindow includes all abstentions/unknowns as nonhits.
definitions.paired: Both methods on precisely the same ranked/resolved windows. Signed retrieval minus clock-baseline top-1 rate.
definitions.interval: Percentile bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 7611674; resample connected test match/account clusters, pool their windows. Null below two contributing clusters; small-n intervals can be degenerate. Conditional on this archive, not live generalization.
definitions.visibleDisplay: Actual observer called without invented POV targets or canAct. Zero display on unannotated compact data is NOT an estimate of live coverage, safety or utility.
definitions.split: Newest ceil(N/4) match IDs by start, include all cutoff ties. Remove whole earlier games sharing a held-out focal account or with unknown/end>=cutoff. end=start+ceil(game duration or recorded terminal clock), not a measured replay publication time.
definitions.rolling: Secondary past-only leave-one-match-and-its-focal-accounts-out at each kickoff. Includes cold starts; earlier test games can become archive for later, unrelated accounts. Not independent of the fixed temporal test.
definitions.examples: First rankable window per hero in chronological test order, selected without looking at correctness. All ranks and next-hit outcomes are retrospective, not observations of live visibility.
